title: E. Krosh and expected value problem

legend: Krosh has been learning probability theory and came up with the following problem: consider an array of $$$n$$$ natural numbers from $$$1$$$ to $$$x$$$ and natural number $$$k$$$. Then $$$k$$$ steps follow, on each step we take current array and simultaneously insert a random number from $$$1$$$ to $$$x$$$ between every pair of adjacent numbers, these numbers are chosen equiprobably and independently on each step and in each step. Krosh is interested what is expected number of segments consisting of the equal numbers after $$$k$$$ steps of the algorithm? For example, if $$$a = [1, 2, 4, 1, 1, 5, 5, 6]$$$, $$$x = 6$$$, then number of segments is $$$6$$$. After one step we can obtain the array: $$$[1, 5, 2, 2, 4, 3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5, 6, 5, 2, 6]$$$ with $$$11$$$ segments.
input: In first line you are given three natural numbers $$$1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, $$$1 \le x \le 10^9$$$, $$$0 \le k \le 10^9$$$. In next line you are given an array of $$$n$$$ natural numbers from $$$1$$$ to $$$x$$$.
output: Output answer modulo $$$10^9+7$$$. Answer can be represented as $$$P/Q$$$, where $$$P$$$ and $$$Q$$$ are non-negative integers and $$$Q  \gt  0$$$. Output $$$P * Q^{-1}$$$ modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.

titleZh.caiyun: E. 克罗什和预期价值问题

legend.deepl: 克罗希一直在学习概率论，并提出了如下问题：考虑一个由 $$$1$$$ 至 $$$x$$$ 的 $$$n$$$ 个自然数和 $$$k$$$ 个自然数组成的数组。然后 $$$k$$$ 步，在每一步中，我们取当前数组，同时在每对相邻数之间插入一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$x$$$ 的随机数，这些数在每一步和每一步中都是等价独立选择的。克罗希感兴趣的是，在算法$$$k$$$步之后，由相等数字组成的段的预期数量是多少？例如，如果$$$a = [1, 2, 4, 1, 1, 5, 5, 6]$$$，$$$x = 6$$$，那么段数就是$$$6$$$。经过一个步骤后，我们可以得到一个数组：$$$[1, 5, 2, 2, 4, 3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 5, 6, 5, 2, 6]$$$ 和 $$$11$$$ 段。
